The '''Hyabb system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Krenher sector/Legends|Krenher sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hyabb]].
